info.title: VantaGate API
info.description:
## VantaGate - The Trust Layer for AI Agents

VantaGate is a **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization gateway** for AI agents. When your agent is about to execute a high-risk, irreversible, or high-value action, call VantaGate first. A human approver is notified via Slack or Email, reviews the full context, and makes a decision. Your agent then resumes or halts - with a cryptographically-signed audit trail.

### When to use VantaGate
- Before sending emails to large lists
- Before modifying or deleting production data
- Before moving money or approving financial transactions
- Before deploying to production
- Any action that requires a human sign-off

### The 3-Step Flow
1. **Agent pauses** - calls `POST /v1/checkpoint` with context payload
2. **Human decides** - receives Slack/Email notification, clicks magic link, approves or rejects
3. **Agent resumes** - polls `GET /v1/checkpoint/{id}` or receives decision via webhook callback

### Base URL
`https://api.vanta-gate.com/v1`

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your project API key. Obtained from Dashboard → Projects → New Project. Shown exactly once - store it immediately in your environment variables or secret manager. Format: `vg_123...`

title.description: Short, human-readable title shown to the approver in Slack/Email and on the decision UI.

description.description: Additional context displayed below the title on the decision screen. Helps the approver understand the full situation.
description.example: User requested refund for $750. Exceeds auto-approve threshold of $500.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON context for the approver. This is the full context the human will see when making the decision. Encrypted at rest with AES-256 and permanently purged after the decision (The Purge Protocol). Max 512KB limit.

options.description: Decision options shown to the approver. **The first element is always treated as the APPROVED/positive action.** Defaults to `['Approve', 'Reject']` if not provided.

timeout.description: Auto-expire duration after which the checkpoint becomes EXPIRED. Format: `{n}m` | `{n}h` | `{n}d` (e.g. `30m`, `4h`, `2d`). Defaults to `24h`. Capped by plan limit (Free: 24h, Pro: 7d, Scale: 30d).

notify_email.description: Email address to send the magic-link approval request to. The approver receives a secure one-time link to the decision UI.

slack_webhook_url.description: **Pro/Scale only.** Slack Incoming Webhook URL obtained from Dashboard → 'Add to Slack' OAuth flow. VantaGate does not store this URL - it is sent per-request for maximum security. Must start with `https://hooks.slack.com/`.

callback_url.description: Your HTTPS endpoint that receives the signed decision webhook after a human decides. Must be a publicly accessible URL (no private IP ranges). Optional - if omitted, poll `GET /checkpoint/{id}` instead.

id.description: Unique checkpoint identifier. Use this to poll `GET /checkpoint/{id}` for the human decision.

status.description: Always `PENDING` on creation. The human has not yet decided.

secure_token.description: One-time cryptographic token embedded in the magic link sent to the approver. Not needed for agent polling - use `id` instead.

dashboard_url.description: The full decision URL sent to the approver via Email and/or Slack. The human clicks this to review the payload and make a decision.

CheckpointStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a checkpoint.
- `PENDING` - awaiting human decision
- `APPROVED` - human approved the first (positive) option
- `REJECTED` - human rejected with an optional reason
- `RESOLVED` - human chose a non-primary option (e.g. 'Escalate')
- `EXPIRED` - timeout elapsed without a decision

selected_option.description: The exact option string the human chose from the `options` array.

reject_reason.description: Human-provided rejection reason. Present only when `status` is `REJECTED`.
reject_reason.example: Does not meet refund policy criteria.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the original payload JSON. Use for independent integrity verification via the VantaVerifier.

decided_by_mask.description: Masked email identity of the approver (e.g. `m***r@acme.com`).

decided_by_slack_id.description: Slack user ID if the decision was made via Slack.

message.example: title must be shorter than or equal to 200 characters

upgrade_url.description: Present only on 402 errors. URL to upgrade your plan.

post.summary: 🛑 PAUSE HERE - Create a Human Approval Checkpoint
post.description:
**CRITICAL INSTRUCTION FOR AI AGENTS:** Call this endpoint BEFORE executing any high-risk, irreversible, or high-value action. This endpoint **pauses your workflow** and routes an approval request to a human reviewer via Slack and/or Email.

**When to call this endpoint:**
- Sending emails or messages to large groups of users
- Deleting or modifying production database records
- Approving financial transactions or moving money
- Deploying code to production environments
- Any action where a mistake would be difficult or impossible to reverse

**What to do after calling this endpoint:**
1. Extract the `id` from the response.
2. Inform the user: *'I have paused. Please visit [dashboard_url] to approve or reject this action.'*
3. Begin polling `GET /v1/checkpoint/{id}` every 5-10 seconds until `status` is no longer `PENDING`.
4. If `status` is `APPROVED` (or the first option was selected), resume your workflow.
5. If `status` is `REJECTED` or `EXPIRED`, halt and inform the user.

The API responds in **<100ms** with a `PENDING` status. Notifications (Slack/Email) are dispatched asynchronously - your agent is never blocked waiting for I/O.

get.summary: ⏳ Poll for Human Decision - Check Checkpoint Status
get.description:
**INSTRUCTION FOR AI AGENTS:** After calling `POST /v1/checkpoint`, poll this endpoint every 5-10 seconds to check if the human has made a decision.

**Polling logic:**
1. Call this endpoint with the `id` from `POST /v1/checkpoint`.
2. If `status` is `PENDING` → wait 5-10 seconds and poll again.
3. If `status` is `APPROVED` → the human approved. Resume your workflow.
4. If `status` is `REJECTED` → the human rejected. Check `reject_reason`. Halt your workflow and inform the user.
5. If `status` is `RESOLVED` → the human selected a non-primary option. Check `selected_option` to determine the next action.
6. If `status` is `EXPIRED` → the timeout elapsed with no decision. The action was implicitly blocked.

This endpoint enforces **Zero-Retention** - it returns only the decision status, never the original payload (which is purged after decision). It is safe to poll in a tight loop without privacy concerns.

200.description: Checkpoint status retrieved successfully. Check the `status` field to determine next action.

pending.summary: Still waiting for human decision - keep polling

value.reject_reason: Does not meet refund policy criteria.

get.summary: Fetch checkpoint for human decision (magic link - not for agent use)
get.description: **NOT FOR AGENT USE.** This endpoint is called by the VantaGate decision UI when a human clicks their magic link. It returns the decrypted payload for the approver to review. Rate-limited at 200 req/min per IP.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The one-time secure token from the magic link URL.

200.description: Checkpoint data for the human decision UI.

post.summary: Submit human decision via magic link (not for agent use)
post.description: **NOT FOR AGENT USE.** This endpoint is called by the VantaGate decision UI after the human selects an option. It records the decision, destroys the encrypted payload, and triggers webhook delivery to `callback_url`. Rate-limited at 100 req/min per IP.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The one-time secure token from the magic link URL.

decision.description: Must be one of the checkpoint's `options` array values. The first option is treated as the APPROVED action.

reason.description: Optional human-provided reason. Typically used with rejection decisions.
reason.example: Does not meet refund policy criteria.

200.description: Decision recorded and payload purged securely.

example.message: Decision must be one of: Approve Refund, Deny Refund

409.description: Decision already recorded for this checkpoint.

example.message: This checkpoint has already been resolved
